description: Source code for HiveServer2, a component of Apache Hive that provides a server interface for executing Hive queries, managing configurations, and handling shutdown procedures. It includes command-line argument processing, server startup logic, and integration with Spark logging.

classes.name: HiveServer2
classes.description: Main class for the HiveServer2 service, managing initialization, startup, shutdown, and command-line argument processing.

classes.name: ServerOptionsProcessor
classes.description: Processes command-line options for HiveServer2, including configuration properties and help command.

classes.name: ServerOptionsProcessorResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response from command-line parsing, including the executor to run.

classes.name: ServerOptionsExecutor
classes.description: Interface defining the execute method for server command execution.

classes.name: HelpOptionExecutor
classes.description: Executes the help command, printing usage information.

classes.name: StartOptionExecutor
classes.description: Default executor that starts the HiveServer2 service.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HiveServer2 service with configuration, setting up CLI services and shutdown hooks.

methods.name: isHTTPTransportMode
methods.description: Checks if the server should run in HTTP transport mode based on environment variable or configuration.

methods.name: startHiveServer2
methods.description: Contains logic to attempt starting HiveServer2 with retries and JVM pause monitoring.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for starting HiveServer2, processing command-line arguments, and executing commands.
